title: Annie
creator: CrossFit
description: A descending ladder of double-unders and sit-ups: 50 of each, then 40, 30, 20 and 10. Named after CrossFit original Annie Sakamoto and first posted in 2005, it is short, fast and mostly a test of how clean your rope skills are. Scale with single-unders at double the count or a lower rep scheme.
